title: Line up the ends, then put three in order

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Put the trains in order from shortest to longest.

do.text: Put the trains in order from shortest to longest.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: The red train goes the farthest to the right, so red is the longest one.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Line up the ends first. Draw a start line, and slide each train up to it.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Oh, now green goes past the other two. Green is the longest train.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Red only looked long because it started farther to the right.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Shortest to longest: red, yellow, green.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The purple snake is shorter than the blue snake.

do.text: The purple snake is shorter than the blue snake. The blue snake is shorter than the green snake. Put the snakes in order from shortest to longest.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The blue snake is shorter than the green snake.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Put the snakes in order from shortest to longest.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Blue is longer than purple, and blue is shorter than green.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: So blue goes between them. Purple is the shortest, and green is the longest.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: So the order is purple, blue, green.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The yellow scarf is longer than the red scarf.

do.text: The yellow scarf is longer than the red scarf. The blue scarf is longer than the yellow scarf. Which scarf is the longest?

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: The blue scarf is longer than the yellow scarf.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: Blue is longer than yellow, and yellow is longer than red.

beats.speaker: learner
beats.say: So blue is longer than both. Blue is the longest scarf.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Yes. And red is shorter than yellow, so red is the shortest.

beats.speaker: teacher
beats.say: Line up the ends. Then find the one that goes in between.
